48.original: <gasp> Who should stand before me but the savior of the very star─the inimitable ender of the end! Your deeds are sung of far and wide, my friend!

49.original: As I understand it, your quest for the world's salvation brought you to Sharlayan. I, too, am here on a quest of sorts─the quest for musical inspiration.

50.original: Alas, magnificent though this repository of knowledge may be, I find there is only so much inspiration I can derive from tomes...

51.original: But where tomes alone fail to inspire, living words may yet spark the imagination!

52.original: So I beg you, will you not regale me with the tale of your quest to deliver the star? If such an adventure isn't fit to be an epic, I would not know what is!

53.original: Drawing upon both your firsthand account and the knowledge I attain here, I believe that I shall be able to weave the most marvelous of verses!

54.original: Should you be willing, pray let me know. I shall continue my research here in the meantime.
